sandbox.note: Engines that build the project (needs_build) run in bubblewrap when it is installed (no network, a read-only view of the tree, private scratch directories); without it they run unsandboxed and a note says so. {dir} is a cache directory, {out} and {home} are private directories of the run.

coursier.fill: with network access: COURSIER_CACHE={dir} cs fetch <the indexer artifact and its dependencies>

gradle.fill: with network access: run the project's gradle build once with GRADLE_USER_HOME={dir}

nuget.fill: with network access: NUGET_PACKAGES={dir} dotnet restore <the solution>

cargo.fill: with network access: cargo vendor {dir}/vendor and put the source replacement it prints into {dir}/config.toml

gomod.fill: with network access: GOMODCACHE={dir} go mod download (the exact commands: dead-code-checker graph cache go --fill REPO); what is still missing: dead-code-checker graph cache go --check REPO

npm.fill: with network access: npm_config_cache={dir} npm ci
